title: Property Charge Advance Repayment — Scope of Advanced Charges and Covered Loans
content:
This scope statement for Property Charge Advance Repayment sets which delinquent property charges Cedarline advances, which loans the arrangement covers, when a record opens and how many records a loan may hold open.

| Arrangement | Charges advanced when unpaid | Homeowners-association dues advanced | Advance made because a set-aside was short is included | Loan programs covered | Record opens on the first unrepaid advance | Open arrangements per loan (at most) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lump-Sum Repayment | Property tax; hazard insurance; flood insurance | No | Yes | HECM; Cedarline Summit | Yes | 1 |
| Repayment Plan - 12 Months | Property tax; hazard insurance; flood insurance | No | Yes | HECM; Cedarline Summit | Yes | 1 |
| Repayment Plan - 24 Months | Property tax; hazard insurance; flood insurance | No | Yes | HECM; Cedarline Summit | Yes | 1 |
| Repayment Plan - 36 Months | Property tax; hazard insurance; flood insurance | No | Yes | HECM; Cedarline Summit | Yes | 1 |
| Repayment Plan - 60 Months | Property tax; hazard insurance; flood insurance | No | Yes | HECM; Cedarline Summit | Yes | 1 |
| At-Risk Extension | Property tax; hazard insurance; flood insurance | No | Yes | HECM; Cedarline Summit | Yes | 1 |

## Scope in brief

- **Charges.** Three charge types are advanced when unpaid: property tax, hazard insurance and flood insurance.
- **Association dues.** Delinquent homeowners-association dues are not advanced under any arrangement.
- **Set-aside shortfalls.** A corporate advance made because a set-aside was short is included in the arrearage.
- **Loans.** The arrangement applies to HECM loans and to Cedarline Summit loans.
- **Opening.** An arrangement record opens on the first unrepaid advance.
- **Limit.** A loan holds at most 1 open arrangement.

### Hypothetical scope check

| Hypothetical charge Cedarline paid on a borrower's behalf | Within the advanced charge types |
|---|---|
| A county property tax installment | Yes |
| A flood insurance renewal premium | Yes |
| A homeowners-association quarterly assessment | No |

The rows are illustrative only.
